text:
I visited the doctor because I broke a tooth while traveling.
The doctor is a woman who speaks English well.
Since my English isn't very good, I used a translator to check the technical terms and important information.
The doctor's kind and detailed explanations were very helpful.
The doctor took the time to provide meticulous treatment, and the cost was reasonable.
I was depressed because of the accident, but thanks to the meticulous treatment, I was able to complete my trip safely.
Thank you.
